questions.q: List four signs that tell you a chemical reaction has taken place.
questions.a: Change of state, change of colour, evolution of a gas, and change of temperature indicate a reaction.

questions.q: Is burning of a matchstick a chemical change? Why?
questions.a: Yes - the match head burns to new substances (gas, ash) with heat and light, which cannot be undone.

questions.q: What shows that mixing lime in water is a chemical reaction?
questions.a: Slaked lime forms with a rise in temperature - new substance and heat change signal a reaction.

questions.q: Why is it wrong to write an unbalanced equation in practice?
questions.a: An unbalanced equation breaks the law of conservation of mass by showing atoms appearing or vanishing.

questions.q: State the law of conservation of mass.
questions.a: Mass can neither be created nor destroyed in a chemical reaction, so total mass of reactants equals that of products.
2H2 + O2 -> 2H2O - four hydrogens and two oxygens on each side.

questions.q: Name the four basic types of chemical reactions with one example each.
questions.a: Combination (CaO + water), decomposition (heating lime stone), displacement (iron in copper sulphate), double displacement (barium chloride with sodium sulphate).

questions.q: What type of reaction is respiration?
questions.a: Exothermic - glucose breaks down with oxygen releasing energy.

questions.q: Which reaction type converts quicklime to slaked lime?
questions.a: Combination - calcium oxide combines with water to form calcium hydroxide.

concepts.title: Effects of Oxidation in Daily Life

questions.q: What is the economic effect of corrosion of iron?
questions.a: Rusting damages machines, rails and ships; crores of rupees are lost yearly replacing corroded iron.

questions.q: How does applying a coat of grease prevent rusting?
questions.a: The oily film keeps air and moisture away from the iron surface.

questions.q: What is the rancidity problem in packaged foods?
questions.a: Oxidised fats develop bad taste and smell; nitrogen flushing and airtight packs prevent it.
